# Signature Llama: The Fully Cyber Utilizable AI — llms.txt

> A tiny transformer language model I built and trained from scratch.
> It runs entirely in the browser: no API keys, no servers, no fees —
> currently free for all internet tasks. Free for any website, app, or
> project. Independent model. Not affiliated with Meta or the LLaMA model family.

Site: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-llama/

## What it is

- Decoder-only transformer, hand-written from scratch (no borrowed code,
  no pretrained weights).
- ~3 million parameters (v1). Character-level tokenizer trained on the
  IWB Dictionary and Signature spec text.
- Training data: the IWB Dictionary's original definitions plus the
  Signature spec archive — original text only. Honest about its size:
  small, lively,
  a little quirky in v1; grows over time.
- Status: training in progress. The site auto-detects publication and the
  status pill flips from NOW TRAINING to LIVE by itself.

## Where the files live

- Engine (pure JavaScript, zero dependencies):
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/sigllama/sigllama.js
- Weights (int8, published when training completes):
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/sigllama/sigllama-v1.bin
- Vocabulary:
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/sigllama/vocab.json
- Whole patch (engine + weights or placeholder + vocab + sources +
  dictionary + knowledge base + embed snippet + patch notes):
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-llama/patch/signature-llama-patch-v1.zip
- Machine-readable manifest (start here for integration):
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-llama/llama-manifest.json
- This site's source tools (tokenizer, model, trainer, exporter/quantizer,
  corpus builder, parity checker):
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-llama/src/

## How to call the API

Option A — ask a question, get an answer (easiest, works today):
  <script src="https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-llama/llama-api.js"></script>
  <script>
    SignatureLlama.ask("What is a token?").then(function(answer){
      console.log(answer);
    });
  </script>
  SignatureLlama.ask(question) returns a Promise of a string. Answers come
  from the on-site knowledge base now and upgrade to the trained model
  automatically once it publishes.

Option B — run the trained model yourself (browser or webview):
  <script src="https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/sigllama/sigllama.js"></script>
  <script>
    await SigLlama.load("https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/sigllama/");
    const text = await SigLlama.generate("Hello,", { maxTokens: 80, temperature: 0.8, topK: 40 });
  </script>
  SigLlama.generate(prompt, { maxTokens, temperature, topK, stopAtEos, onToken })
  also supports onToken for streaming. SigLlama.info() returns model facts.
  SigLlama.loaded() reports whether weights are present.

Option C — ask through the site URL (opens the page with the on-site
guide answering the question):
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-llama/?ask=YOUR_QUESTION

Option D — open a dictionary word directly:
  https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-llama/?term=transformer

## On-site resources for AI readers

- The Explainer (on-site guide AI + knowledge base of every file,
  library, and tool): /#guide — data/explainer-kb.json
- Signature Inventory (every building block, downloadable):
  /#inventory
- LLM/AI Dictionary (312 original one-sentence definitions, A–Z,
  searchable, machine-readable): /#dictionary —
  data/llm-dictionary.json
- Tool Library (120+ plug-in tool libraries of real runnable JS —
  text, reasoning, memory, chat, search, math, web, data, voice,
  safety, embed, fun — with an optimal all-purpose setting):
  /#toollib — data/tool-libraries.json
- AI Access section (copy-paste instructions): /#ai-access
